pages.text: The Spirit Drive is non-stacking. Use an unbound drive in the air to claim it; its tooltip shows the latest owner name. A valid legacy session UUID migrates in place to the persistent ImmortalStorage identity without clearing item data, and another player cannot force a rebind.

The drive is a reusable fuel credential, not consumable fuel. In a vanilla furnace or ImmortalStorage machine, it charges one Immortal Yuan from its online owner's personal storage, then one True Yuan if needed; the personal-realm owner takes priority when the machine is inside that realm. Closing Xianqiao Output does not disable a drive already placed in the fuel slot; only the empty-slot automatic refill is gated. With no available balance, the machine waits and retries.

Immortal Furnaces, Simulated Reincarnation Furnaces, Simulated Spirit Fields, and Energy Crystals accept the drive. Outside a personal realm an unbound or unclaimed drive binds nobody. Machine contents, outputs, and the drive itself remain intact across launcher changes; ownership shares the same persistent identity as personal realms, storage media, interfaces, and Substitute Puppets.
